mutations.content:
on shoot:
    if shooter is a player:
        if player's tool is a bow named "&cTNT Bow":
            set metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile to true

on projectile hit:
    if metadata "is_tnt_arrow" of projectile is true:
        spawn primed tnt at location of projectile
        delete projectile

command /give-tnt-bow:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give player a bow named "&cTNT Bow" with lore "&7Shoots explosive TNT arrows."

traces.intent_summary: Create a custom bow that spawns primed TNT at the location where an arrow lands.

traces.rationale: I used the 'on shoot' event to tag the arrow with metadata to ensure only arrows fired from the specific bow trigger the effect. The 'on projectile hit' event handles the spawning of the primed TNT at the impact location and removes the arrow entity to prevent further collisions.
